newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin moves to Rus residence to finish recovery.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin moves to Rus residence to finish recovery.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin moved on Monday to his Rus country residence, west of Moscow, for the a "final stage" of his rehabilitation after a heart bypass operation, the Kremlin said.

Yeltsin's press office said the Rus, situated 100 km (60 miles) from Moscow, had better facilities for the outdoor recreations of the 65-year-old president than Gorky-9 residence just outside the capital where he had stayed until now.
"It has conditions allowing both the finalising of rehabilitation and work and active recreation," a brief press office statement said.

Kremlin doctors say Yeltsin, who had multiple bypass surgery on November 5 is recovering well. The head of parliament's upper house, Yegor Stroyev, who visited Yeltsin last week, has said the president could make a trial visit to his Kremlin office by December 25.
The Kremlin has said Yeltsin will meet German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, expected in Moscow on January 4, at Rus.
